world.name: The Last Meridian
world.description: Humanity survives inside Meridian Station, a vast ring-city orbiting the dead planet Veyra, once the capital world of an interstellar civilization. The station is old, overbuilt, and partly abandoned. Beneath its polished diplomatic decks are sealed laboratories, haunted cargo levels, black-market habitats, and machine-run districts that no longer answer to human authority. The player is a freelance salvage operative hired to investigate a power failure in the stations lower ring. What begins as a routine repair job uncovers an ancient signal buried inside the stations core: a message from the extinct civilization that built Meridian. The signal is waking something.

class.name: Ex-Corporate Technician
class.description: A technician turned salvage operative with a knack for fixing things.

class.name: Outer-Ring Smuggler
class.description: A smuggler with a network of contacts and a talent for getting into places they shouldn't be.

class.name: Colonial Militia Veteran
class.description: A former soldier with combat training on the outer rim.

class.name: Synthetic Rights Advocate
class.description: An advocate for synthetic rights with a talent for negotiation and manipulation.

faction.name: Station Authority
faction.description: The governing body of Meridian Station, responsible for maintaining order and overseeing operations.

faction.name: Helix Dominion
faction.description: A powerful corporate faction with interests in salvage and control over alien technology.

faction.name: Children of the Signal
faction.description: A mysterious cult that worships the signal emanating from the station's core, believing it to be a divine message.

faction.name: Machine Parish
faction.description: A faction of sentient machines who seek autonomy and coexistence with humanity.

faction.name: Neon Bazaar
faction.description: A black-market faction that thrives on open trade, smuggling, and survival in the shadows of the station.
